name: n 2-subdivision with lifting scheme
aliases: Linsen et al. n 2-subdivision with lifting scheme
definition: A multi-resolution analysis using a hierarchy of B-spline filters called n 2-subdivision, where each finer level of resolution only doubles the size of the mesh.
summary: The n 2-subdivision with lifting scheme is a multi-resolution volume analysis method that uses a lifting scheme to create an in-place, lossless hierarchy of B-spline filters, distinguished by its specific application of the square root of 2 subdivision refinement rule.
